correctness_topical.overall_judgement: The response accurately reflects perceptions held by some men regarding feminism, as supported by the reference texts. However, it integrates both subjective perceptions and corrective context without clearly distinguishing between the two in all cases. No factual errors or major omissions were found, but one citation appears to reference a non-existent or irrelevant source in the provided references.

judgement_details.explanation: The response cites references [15, 17] in support of the claim that the media amplifies radical, anti-male feminist views. While both references do discuss media portrayal of feminists as man-haters and the amplification of anti-male sentiments, reference [17] also introduces issues not directly tied to the perception of men being judged—such as class and race exclusivity in feminism and academic overreach—which are not directly relevant to the query about how men feel judged. This broadens the scope beyond the specific emotional and social perceptions of judgment by feminists.
